name: Liberate Self
descr:
**Frequency** once per day

**Requirements** You're [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core), [immobilized](/condition/immobilized-player-core), or [restrained](/condition/restrained-player-core)

Attempt to [Escape](/action/escape-player-core), rolling the check twice and taking the better result.

name: Puncture Flesh
descr:
**Trigger** Your last action was to deal piercing damage to an enemy within your reach

Attempt an Athletics check to [Grapple](/action/grapple-player-core) the same enemy. The weapon that dealt the triggering damage gains the [grapple](/trait/grapple) trait for this check. On a success, the target also takes 1d8 [persistent piercing damage](/condition/persistent-damage-player-core) (or 2d8 persistent piercing damage on a critical success). When the target is no longer [grabbed](/condition/grabbed-player-core) or [restrained](/condition/restrained-player-core) by you, the persistent damage ends.

data.trigger: Your last action was to deal piercing damage to an enemy within your reach
